action_items: Minor copy: update HireDevTeamBanner subtitle text from '12 specialists' to '13 specialists' to match the actual roster (Growth added). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/chats.py:851 — StripeCheckout is instantiated with `webhook_url='https://unused.local/webhook'` purely to satisfy the constructor. Works but reads like a footgun if the library ever validates the URL. Consider hoisting a module-level singleton or making webhook_url optional in the library wrapper.

routes/chats.py:824-826 — `tx = await db.payment_transactions.find_one({'session_id': session_id})` does NOT filter by chat_id or workspace_id, so a malicious user could enumerate session_ids across workspaces. The subsequent workspace_id / chat_id check (lines 827-830) does mitigate disclosure, but returning 403 vs 400 leaks the session's existence in another workspace. Consider returning a uniform 404 for cross-tenant lookups.

routes/chats.py:610-632 — idempotency works on `created_at` ISO string comparison ($gte recent_cutoff). ISO string comparison is correct for UTC ISO8601 with the same Z/offset format, but if any older row was written without timezone marker the comparison can mis-fire. Worth normalizing now_iso() everywhere (looks fine in this codebase but is a foot-gun pattern).

routes/chats.py:766-803 — both the ai-system celebratory message and the ai-agent-devmgr intro are inserted serially via two `messages.insert_one + _broadcast_message` calls. If the second insert fails after the first succeeds, the chat ends up with only the system message. Consider wrapping in a bulk insert or accepting the rare partial-state as already idempotent (re-running provision is safe because of the `dev_team_hired` gate so the orphan ai-system stays — but the devmgr intro will be missing forever). Low-priority since both inserts are local.

services/dev_chat_agents.py — kind-gate removal (iter66) means any chat where a user mentions @architect / @qa etc. will summon the agent. The parser still skips code-block mentions, but a quoted user message containing '@qa' would now trigger QA in any chat. Worth a smoke-test if not already done.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — iter66's CRITICAL /status 502 bug is FIXED. Verified by: (a) calling /status on an unpaid valid session_id directly returns 200 applied:false with payment_status='unpaid' (no 502 even though the Emergent Stripe proxy 404s on lookup — logged at INFO level and execution falls through to local-state); (b) flipping the local payment row to status='completed' and re-calling /status returns 200 applied:true and provisions the team. The fix uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status (same proxy that minted the session) wrapped in try/except that treats any error as 'still pending', AND a local-state-first fast-path that handles the webhook-driven completion case without needing any Stripe lookup. Idempotency on POST /hire-dev-team/checkout works: same-user/same-chat within 5min returns the existing pending session_id (verified DB-level: only 1 pending row). Devmgr intro parity verified: chat gets BOTH ai-system + ai-agent-devmgr messages on provision.
